# OpenTimestamps test files

Copied unchanged on 2026-11-16 from the reference client's published
examples, github.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client, folder
examples/: ots-bitcoin-912095.ots is gdp2q25-2nd.pdf.ots, a complete
proof to Bitcoin block 912095; ots-two-calendars.ots is
two-calendars.txt.ots, pending at two calendars. Block 912095's Merkle
root, 936131994129988e1932d8c1c6a9780fd42ae4c87204cfb0ac852be1250039ae,
was read from blockstream.info on 2026-11-16.

rekor-entry-1000000000.json is the public log's entry at index
1000000000, read from https://rekor.sigstore.dev on 2026-11-16.
